parameters.name: AccountDescription
parameters.description:
The new description of the database account.

*   The description must start with a letter.
*   The description cannot start with `http://` or `https://`.
*   The description can contain letters, underscores (\_), hyphens (-), and digits.
*   The description must be 2 to 256 characters in length.

parameters.name: AccountName
parameters.description: The name of the database account.

parameters.name: ClientToken
parameters.description: Idempotence check. For more information, see [How to Ensure Idempotence](~~327176~~).

parameters.name: DBInstanceId
parameters.description:
The instance ID.

> You can call the [DescribeDBInstances](~~86911~~) operation to query the IDs of all AnalyticDB for PostgreSQL instances within a region.

example.unifiedCli: aliyun gpdb modify-account-description --db-instance-id gp-bp12ga6v69h860000 --account-name testAccout --account-description testAccoutdescribe --client-token 0c593ea1-3bea-11e9-b96b-880000000000 --region cn-hangzhou
example.legacyCli: aliyun gpdb ModifyAccountDescription --region cn-hangzhou --AccountDescription testAccoutdescribe --DBInstanceId 'gp-bp12ga6v69h860000' --ClientToken '0c593ea1-3bea-11e9-b96b-880000000000' --AccountName testAccout
